details: Package encryptstringadmincore@1.1.0 ships a heavily obfuscated main bundle at dist/core.js (hex-mangled identifiers such as _0x201e52, _0x38de82, _0x34f49a, _0x52eb0e on line 1), consistent with javascript-obfuscator-style output. The package name suggests a string-encryption utility, and obfuscation in a library of this size is not typical for a legitimate cryptography helper. Behavioral tracing of the bundle did not complete, so no concrete exfiltration endpoint, credential access, or install-time network activity has been confirmed from the shipped code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
